system.description:
The bo staff, often likened to a quarterstaff, exhibits a slender and graceful design, gently tapering at one end. This versatile martial arts tool serves a dual purpose, functioning not only as a potent weapon but also as a highly effective defensive instrument. Its length and balanced construction allow martial artists to perform a wide array of techniques, making it a favoured choice for practitioners seeking agility and precision in their combat style.

Monastic: A weapon with this trait is specifically designed to be used with complex martial arts techniques. Any ability, feat or spell which can only be applied to an unarmed strike can also be used with a monastic weapon (such as flurry of blows).

Automated (TRG Prime 3.667.0): an ability, feat or spell that applies to an unarmed strike also applies to it.
